raw_text: Make and track predictions about the events and information likely to come next. (I)
competency_statement: Make and keep track of predictions about what will happen next in a text.
observable_behaviors: State what they think will happen next in a story or text.
Explain why they think a certain event or information will come next.
Recall previous predictions and compare them to what actually happens as they read.
skill_clauses: Make predictions about events or information likely to come next in a text.
Track those predictions as reading progresses.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Recognize when a text invites making predictions about upcoming events or information.
student_actions.oral_production: Verbally express predictions about what will happen next in a text.
student_actions.matching_sorting_sequencing: Track the sequence of events and update predictions accordingly.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply the strategy of making and revising predictions while reading.
student_actions.representation_modeling: Model making predictions about text events before and during reading.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain the reasoning behind predictions about upcoming text content.
student_actions.comprehension_response: Respond to texts by making and tracking predictions about future events or information.
